title: Clinical Performance of Paraoxonase-1-Related Variables and Novel Markers of Inflammation in Coronavirus Disease-19. A Machine Learning Approach
summary: Specific clinical biomarker/severity result arises from measured COVID cohort and ML analysis with comparison groups; qualifies narrowly as retrospective clinical result. Version is non-peer-reviewed v1 and association does not establish causation.

evidence.ai_role: Original v1 Methods: retrospective 126 PCR-confirmed hospitalized COVID-19 patients, 50 healthy and 45 pre-pandemic hospital controls; measured PON1/inflammatory markers and ML variable selection/classification assess severity. Results support specific PON1-related variables and inflammatory biomarkers differentiating severity groups. Preprint, single-center, retrospective; markers are associations, not causal or prospective predictors.
